title: Fine-Grained 16-Layer Optimization with Reduced Perturbation and Smoothness Penalty
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining the optimizer to smaller per-layer perturbations (±60nm) and penalizing large inter-layer thickness jumps (>400nm) will enable precise tuning of anti-reflection nulls within the high-performing 16-layer manifold, improving target score beyond 0.9057 without destabilizing the solution.
design_principle: Exploitation-focused optimization: once a high-performing topology is identified (16L HfO2/SiO2 alternating), reduce search space volatility to refine thickness values rather than exploring distant configurations.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Silicon substrate (16 finite layers, alternating sequence starting with HfO2)
design_variables: smoothness penalty weight for inter-layer differences >400nm
soft_objectives: maintain thickness smoothness between adjacent layers
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds 200-1800nm compatible with deposition processes
smoothness constraint reduces extreme thickness variations
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for coherent multilayer interference
Kirchhoff's law equating emissivity to absorptance for opaque substrates
Gradient-based local optimization for fine-tuning near optima
expected_advantages: Higher precision in thickness tuning compared to coarse global search
Reduced risk of jumping away from high-performing manifold
Smoother thickness profiles may improve fabrication tolerance
known_risks: May converge to local optimum if initialization is poor
Smoothness penalty could prevent optimal but discontinuous thickness profiles
16 layers may be insufficient for ideal spectral shaping
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer planar dielectric stack on silicon substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (alternating, starting with HfO2). Each layer thickness bounded between 200nm and 1800nm. Initialize from quarter-wave optical thickness at 10500nm reference wavelength. Use gradient-based optimizer with maximum per-layer perturbation radius of 60nm and soft penalty coefficient of 0.1 for inter-layer thickness differences exceeding 400nm. Evaluate coherent TMM across 3000-13000nm wavelength range at normal incidence. Objective: maximize weighted absorptance (high weight 8000-13000nm, low weight 3000-5000nm). Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: reduce per-layer perturbation radius by 60% (target ±60nm) and add smoothness penalty for inter-layer differences >400nm to enable fine-grained exploitation of the 16L high-performing manifold identified in iteration 11.
